name: Demon, Dementer Quasit
source: The Genius Guide to the Talented Bestiary
book: The Genius Guide to the Talented Bestiary

facets.bk: The Genius Guide to the Talented Bestiary

body:
A feral-looking demon sits on its haunches. Wings are furled high above shoulders and a greasy stripe of hair runs down its back to the tuft of a swinging tail. A dementer quasit is 2 feet tall and weighs 10 pounds.

Dementer Quasit Demon CR 4

XP 1,200
Spellcaster (arcane)
CE Tiny outsider (chaotic, demon, evil, extraplanar)
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 16, flat-footed 16 (+4 Dex, +4 natural, +2 size)
hp 38 (7d6+14)
Fort +4, Ref +6, Will +8
Defensive Abilities ferocity; Immune electricity, poison; Resist acid 10, cold 10, fire 10

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., climb 10 ft., fly 40 ft. (good)
Melee bite +7 (1d3+2 plus 1d4 Wisdom damage), 2 claws +7 (1d2+2)
Space 2 1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks blood rage (free action), maddening gaze (DC 17)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th, concentration +10)

At will bull’s strength, eagle’s splendor, rage (DC 16)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 19, Con 15, Int 12, Wis 16, Cha 17
Base Atk +3; CMB +3; CMD 21
Feats Alertness, Defensive Combat Training, Go Unnoticed, Improved Initiative,
Skills Bluff +7, Climb +16, Fly +18, Intimidate +9, Knowledge (arcana) +12, Knowledge (planes) +7, Linguistics +7, Perception +5, Sense Motive +5, Spellcraft +10, Stealth +13, Use Magic Device +8; Racial Modifiers +2 Intimidate, +4 Knowledge (arcana), +2 Spellcraft
Languages Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Orc, Undercommon; telepathy 100 ft.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Maddening Gaze (Su)

Confused for 1 round as the lesser confusion spell, 30 feet, Will DC 17 negates. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Abyss)
Organization solitary or flock (2-12)
Treasure standard

Dementers offer Abyssal power to mortals at the price of their sanity. They bestow arcane secrets or raw power, but only to those who sacrifice reason and accept the power of raw emotion and desire. When encountered alone, they defend themselves with ferocity, but prefer to use their abilities in support of stronger allies. Dementers love conflict and delight in involving their charges in pointless fights.
